summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan for the gitignored-specs predicate and the distinct non-failure commit-path outcome. The plan adds scripts/lib/specs-ignore-lib.sh with two rc-based predicates, a V13 classification gate in git-commit-scoped.sh consulting that lib before case 1's existence test, two additive non-failure exit codes (8 all-ignored, 9 committed-but-ignored-drop), an 8|9 NOTE arm in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, and the both-postures per-operation contract in git-staging-scope.md. Carried-figure re-validation found the description's 'no ignore-awareness exists anywhere in the commit path' claim false (git-commit-scoped.sh already calls git check-ignore -q in its ephemeral-exclude injection loop) and surfaced three surfaces the research missed: existing test case U5 asserts the exact behaviour V13 supersedes, a new lib+test pair needs manifest.json and suite-classification.data rows, and git-staging-scope.md already carries a 'git check-ignore -q MUST NOT be used' prohibition the plan must reconcile rather than contradict.
